title: Impact of COVID-19 on Singapore International Festival of Arts 2020
what_it_is: Impact of COVID-19 on Singapore International Festival of Arts 2020

sections.label: SIFA 2020 cancellation and local groups
sections.summary: NAC decided not to stage SIFA 2020 from 15 to 31 May 2020 and will work with four local arts groups on future experiences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The top priority of NAC is to ensure the safety and well-being of all patrons, performers and crew involved in SIFA 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Given the evolving COVID-19 situation, NAC has decided not to stage SIFA 2020 as planned from 15 to 31 May 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: This was not a decision taken lightly, but was made because global restrictions on travel, together with our own precautionary and safe distancing measures to reduce local transmission of COVID-19, would have a significant impact on the overall festival experience.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In addition, NAC and AHL will work with local arts groups involved in SIFA 2020 – namely Nine Years Theatre, The Finger Players, The Necessary Stage and Toy Factory Productions – to explore how they can offer innovative arts and culture experiences in the coming months, based on their SIFA works.

sections.label: COVID-19 arts support measures
sections.summary: Budget 2020's Stabilisation and Support Package includes support for arts practitioners, and NAC engages the arts community on measures like CDSA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: As mentioned during the MCCY Committee of Supply debate on 6 March 2020, the Stabilisation and Support Package announced at Budget 2020 includes support for arts practitioners – both organisations and individuals – during the COVID-19 situation, in addition to broad-based measures such as the Self-Employed Persons Training Support Scheme announced by the Ministry of Manpower.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: NAC has been engaging the arts community on these measures, for instance, the Capability Development Scheme for the Arts (CDSA) which will help organisations and individuals upskill their capabilities and position themselves well for the post COVID-19 recovery.

sections.label: SIFA local and overseas participation
sections.summary: SIFA lets local talents showcase their works and interact with overseas performers, with local artists in half of 2018 and 2019 productions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Being a pinnacle arts festival of Singapore, we would like SIFA to allow our talents to showcase the creativity, their works, their talents, but also the chance to interact with overseas performers and arts groups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, for example, for the last two editions in 2018 and 2019, we have local artists involved in half of all the productions and programmes, and that will continue to be the case for future SIFA editions.

sections.label: SIFA local commissions and ticket refunds
sections.summary: Local SIFA productions are all local commissions, so ticket refunds do not affect these groups' ticketing revenue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But I would just like to also clarify that, for example, the local productions for SIFA are all local commissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, the refund of tickets does not have any impact on the ticketing revenue for these groups.
